Considering the complexities of technology and system used by stock brokers and
emanating technology risk thereof, there is a need to further strengthen the system
audit framework. Therefore, it has been decided to introduce technology based
mechanism to monitor and supervise the way in which the system audits are
conducted and to prescribe eligibility criteria for the empanelment of auditors to
ensure that audits are conducted in a stipulated manner.

mechanism:

create technology based mechanisms to monitor and supervise the
entire system audit lifecycle of a stock broker.

audit of SBs through online monitoring mechanism. As part of the
monitoring mechanism, exchanges shall capture the geo location of
the auditor to ensure that physical visit is carried out by auditor in the
premises of the stock broker.

accessed by the auditor during the audit. Exchanges shall ensure

of information between Stock Exchanges, Depositories and Clearing
